title: Import existing FHIR Server
description: Detects an existing HAPI FHIR JPA Starter server and registers it as an Nx project without scaffolding a new one.

directory.description: The directory containing the existing HAPI FHIR server. Defaults to the workspace root.

name.description: The Nx project name to register. Defaults to the directory name.

packageBase.description: The Java package path for custom code. Auto-detected from src/main/java when omitted.

release.description: The HAPI FHIR JPA Starter release this server corresponds to. Auto-correlated from pom.xml when omitted.

fhirVersion.description: The FHIR version of the server. Auto-detected from application.yaml when omitted.
